implementation.name: original-v2-fusion-before-after
implementation.scope: Original HBM-boundary chain; symbolic intermediate tensors; intermediate traffic only.
implementation.question: Which intermediate tensors actually cross HBM?

purpose: Make intermediate residence, HBM copies, local handoff, and last use visible.
storyboard: Separate path writes and rereads I1; fused path retains it locally.
Activation consumes I1 and creates I2.
Repeat HBM write/read versus on-chip handoff.
Normalization emits Y and releases last-use intermediates.
guard: Two intermediates each one write and read; common traffic excluded; no transfer-to-speed proportionality; on-chip capacity assumption explicit.
